Name: Triple Threat
Effect: This Pokémon's Moves without the Successive Actions tag can be used up to 3 times in a row as if they were Successive Actions. (Note: Replaces or adds a Hidden Ability for Dugtrio, Hydreigon, Magneton, Magnezone, Alolan Dugtrio, Dodrio, Wugtrio, Exeggutor, Alolan Exeggutor)
